gold.question: Tổng tiền gửi cuối tháng 12/1998 là bao nhiêu?
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(total_deposits, 2) AS total_deposits_dec_1998 FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi WHERE year_month = '1998-12' LIMIT 1000

gold.question: How many accounts were active in December 1998?
gold.sql: SELECT active_accounts FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi WHERE year_month = '1998-12' LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Số tài khoản mở mới mỗi năm?
gold.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_start) AS INT) AS opened_year, SUM(new_accounts) AS new_accounts_count FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_start) ORDER BY opened_year LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Tổng tiền vào (credit) của năm 1997 là bao nhiêu?
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(credit_amount), 2) AS total_credit_1997 FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi WHERE SUBSTRING(year_month FROM 1 FOR 4) = '1997' LIMIT 1000

gold.question: So sánh tổng tiền vào giữa quý 3 và quý 4 năm 1998
gold.answer: Tổng tiền vào quý 3 năm 1998 là 7106542597.4, tổng tiền vào quý 4 năm 1998 là 7605386793.2.
gold.sql: SELECT d.quarter AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(m.credit_amount), 2) AS total_credit FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi AS m JOIN core.dim_date AS d ON m.month_start = d.month_start WHERE d.year = 1998 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4) GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY d.quarter LIMIT 1000

attempts.sql: SELECT q.quarter, round(sum(m.credit_amount), 2) AS total_credit FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi m JOIN core.dim_date d ON m.month_start = d.month_start WHERE d.year = 1998 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4) GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY d.quarter

gold.question: Tháng nào năm 1998 có tỷ lệ tài khoản hoạt động thấp nhất?
gold.sql: SELECT year_month, ROUND(CAST(active_rate AS DECIMAL), 4) AS active_rate FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi WHERE year_month LIKE '1998-%' ORDER BY active_rate ASC LIMIT 1

gold.question: How many customers are in each RFM segment?
gold.answer: Potential: 1488, Hibernating: 849, Loyal: 842, At risk: 544, Champions: 536, Needs attention: 241
gold.sql: SELECT rfm_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.mart_customer_360 GROUP BY rfm_segment ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Phân khúc RFM nào có số dư bình quân năm 1998 cao nhất?
gold.sql: SELECT rfm_segment, ROUND(CAST(AVG(avg_end_balance_1998) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_balance_1998 FROM marts.mart_customer_360 WHERE avg_end_balance_1998 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfm_segment ORDER BY avg_balance_1998 DESC LIMIT 1

gold.question: Có bao nhiêu khách có nguy cơ rời bỏ?
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS churn_risk_customers FROM marts.mart_customer_360 WHERE is_churn_risk = TRUE LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Tỷ lệ khách có thẻ theo giới tính
gold.sql: SELECT gender, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN has_card THEN 1 END) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*), 4) AS card_rate FROM marts.mart_customer_360 GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender LIMIT 1000

gold.question: How many cards of each type have been issued?
gold.sql: SELECT card_type, COUNT(*) AS number_of_cards FROM core.fact_cards GROUP BY card_type ORDER BY number_of_cards DESC LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Tỷ lệ vỡ nợ chung của các khoản vay là bao nhiêu?
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_default THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*), 4) AS overall_default_rate, COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN is_default THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS default_loans FROM marts.mart_loan_performance LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Tỷ lệ vỡ nợ theo vùng, cao nhất trước
gold.sql: SELECT region, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE is_default) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*), 4) AS default_rate, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM marts.mart_loan_performance GROUP BY region ORDER BY default_rate DESC LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Tổng giá trị các khoản vay bị vỡ nợ
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_defaulted_loan_amount FROM marts.mart_loan_performance WHERE is_default = TRUE LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Số khoản vay và tổng tiền giải ngân theo năm
gold.sql: SELECT granted_year AS year, COUNT(loan_id) AS number_of_loans, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount FROM marts.mart_loan_performance GROUP BY granted_year ORDER BY granted_year LIMIT 1000

gold.question: What is the default rate for loans of customers who had penalty interest before the loan was granted?
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_default THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS default_rate_percentage, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM marts.mart_loan_performance WHERE n_penalty_interest_before > 0 LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Khoản vay trung bình theo kỳ hạn (số tháng)
gold.sql: SELECT duration_months, ROUND(CAST(AVG(amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_loan_amount, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans FROM marts.mart_loan_performance GROUP BY duration_months ORDER BY duration_months LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Top 5 quận có tiền gửi tháng 12/1998 lớn nhất
gold.sql: SELECT district_name, region, ROUND(deposits_dec_1998, 2) AS deposits_dec_1998 FROM marts.mart_district_kpi ORDER BY deposits_dec_1998 DESC LIMIT 5

gold.question: Quận nào có tỷ lệ thất nghiệp năm 1996 cao nhất?
gold.sql: SELECT district_name, region, unemployment_rate_96 FROM marts.mart_district_kpi WHERE unemployment_rate_96 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY unemployment_rate_96 DESC LIMIT 1

gold.question: Số khách hàng theo vùng
gold.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS number_of_customers FROM marts.mart_customer_360 GROUP BY region ORDER BY number_of_customers DESC LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Bao nhiêu giao dịch rút tiền bằng thẻ trong năm 1998?
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_card_withdrawals_1998 FROM core.fact_transactions AS t JOIN core.dim_date AS d ON t.date_key = d.date_key WHERE t.operation = 'card_withdrawal' AND d.year = 1998 LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Total amount of pension payments received in 1998
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_pension_amount FROM core.fact_transactions WHERE purpose = 'pension' AND direction = 'credit' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM transaction_date) = 1998 LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Tổng phí sao kê ngân hàng thu được theo năm
gold.sql: SELECT d.year, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS total_statement_fees FROM core.fact_transactions AS t JOIN core.dim_date AS d ON t.date_key = d.date_key WHERE t.purpose = 'statement_fee' GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Có bao nhiêu lần khách bị tính lãi phạt?
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS penalty_interest_count FROM core.fact_transactions WHERE purpose = 'penalty_interest' LIMIT 1000

gold.question: 10 tài khoản có tổng tiền vào năm 1998 lớn nhất
gold.sql: SELECT account_id, ROUND(CAST(SUM(credit_amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_credit_1998 FROM marts.mart_account_monthly WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_start) = 1998 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY total_credit_1998 DESC LIMIT 10

gold.question: Tuổi trung bình của khách hàng nữ và nam
gold.sql: SELECT gender, ROUND(CAST(AVG(age_at_as_of) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_age FROM core.dim_customer GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Số tài khoản theo tần suất sao kê
gold.sql: SELECT statement_frequency, COUNT(*) AS number_of_accounts FROM marts.mart_customer_360 GROUP BY statement_frequency ORDER BY number_of_accounts DESC LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Số lệnh chuyển tiền định kỳ theo mục đích
gold.sql: SELECT purpose, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM core.fact_standing_orders GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY number_of_orders DESC LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Tăng trưởng tiền gửi tháng 12/1998 so với tháng 12/1997 là bao nhiêu phần trăm?
gold.sql: WITH monthly_deposits AS (SELECT year_month, total_deposits FROM marts.mart_monthly_kpi WHERE year_month IN ('1997-12', '1998-12')), d97 AS (SELECT total_deposits AS d FROM monthly_deposits WHERE year_month = '1997-12'), d98 AS (SELECT total_deposits AS d FROM monthly_deposits WHERE year_month = '1998-12') SELECT ROUND(((d98.d - d97.d) / d97.d) * 100.0, 4) AS deposit_growth_percentage FROM d97, d98 LIMIT 1000

gold.question: Khách nhóm tuổi nào có tỷ lệ vỡ nợ cao nhất?
gold.sql: SELECT age_band, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_default THEN 1 END) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS default_rate_percentage FROM marts.mart_loan_performance GROUP BY age_band ORDER BY default_rate_percentage DESC LIMIT 1
